blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Businesses in Cebu City affected by accidental fires could receive financial assistance under a proposed ordinance filed by City Councilor Alvin B. Arcilla. The measure, which is scheduled to be tackled during the Cebu City Council’s regular session on Tuesday, November 17, seeks to help establishments recover from fire incidents while providing financial protection to businesses that pay local taxes. Relief based on five years of tax payments Under the proposal, businesses may qualify for financial relief if at least 50% of their facilities in Cebu City have been destroyed by an accidental fire, as certified by […]...
